triples.head_surface: Coupling halves and pulleys must be fitted on the shaft by using suitable equipment and tools which do not damage the bearings and seals
triples.head_canonical_zh: 使用合适工具安装联轴器半体和皮带轮
triples.evidence_text: Coupling halves and pulleys must be fitted on the shaft by using suitable equipment and tools which do not damage the bearings and seals.

triples.head_surface: Never fit a coupling half or pulley by hammering or by removing it using a lever pressed against the body of the motor
triples.head_canonical_zh: 禁止锤击或撬动安装联轴器/皮带轮
triples.evidence_text: Never fit a coupling half or pulley by hammering or by removing it using a lever pressed against the body of the motor.

triples.tail_surface: bearing, vibration and possible shaft failures

triples.evidence_text: Correct alignment is essential to avoid bearing, vibration and possible shaft failures.

triples.head_surface: Mounting accuracy of coupling half: check that clearance b is less than 0.05 mm and that the difference a1 to a2 is also less than 0.05 mm
triples.head_canonical_zh: 检查联轴器半体安装精度
triples.tail_surface: clearance b is less than 0.05 mm and that the difference a1 to a2 is also less than 0.05 mm

triples.evidence_text: Mounting accuracy of coupling half: check that clearance b is less than 0.05 mm and that the difference a1 to a2 is also less than 0.05 mm.

triples.head_surface: Re-check the alignment after final tightening of the bolts or studs
triples.head_canonical_zh: 最终紧固后重新检查对中
triples.evidence_text: Re-check the alignment after final tightening of the bolts or studs.

triples.head_surface: Check that drain holes and plugs face downwards
triples.head_canonical_zh: 检查排水孔和塞子朝下
